Title: FRAME-BY-FRAME SWITCHING OF DVB-S2X AND RCS2 IN RETURN LINK (ARTES AT 3C.053) (ON DELEGATION REQUEST)
Theme: Objective: The objective of this activity is to develop and test a prototype terminal capable of DVB-S2X and RCS2 real-time switching in the return link utilising a Commercial-off-the-Shelf (COTS) modem ASIC. Title: HE-SWE-03B - GLOBAL MULTI-MOMENT MULTI-FLUID MODEL OF THE MAGNETOSPHERE
Theme: The Agency seeks to assess the applicability and operational potential of a multi-moment, multi-fluid modelling approach for forecasting and nowcasting the Earth's magnetospheric space weather environment. While current operational systems predominantly rely on global MHD models and fully kinetic approaches remain computationally challenging for routine use, this activity aims to demonstrate whether a multi-fluid framework can provide an effective balance between physical realism and operational performance. Title: MOONLIGHT STANDARD CALL FOR PROPOSALS - PRODUCT ACTIVITIES
Theme: This Call for Proposals is for industry-initiated Product Activities for the Moonlight Programme. Participating States' industries,satellite operators, service providers, in cooperation with users and customer communities when relevant, as well as universities and research institutes, may submit proposals to the call at their own initiative and at any time.
